joins.purpose: Know when each dish is done without watching the clock.
joins.ef: The timer counts down each named dish and rings when one reaches zero.
joins.relation: The kitchen timer tells the cook when a dish is done.
joins.observation: A kitchen timer counts down a set time.

joins.purpose: Get the cook's attention the moment a countdown ends.
joins.ef: The alarm plays a tone on the speaker until the cook presses stop.
joins.relation: The alarm rings for the timer.
joins.observation: A piezo speaker driven by one GPIO pin.

subtypes.ef: tick_all subtracts one second from each running countdown.
subtypes.relation: The tick loop advances every running countdown.
